At Xatzis Motors

Photos from the dealership’s Google listing.

A family run dealership

Xatzis Motors is on Agias Pylis street in Aradippou near Larnaca, open Monday to Saturday. Its website lists over 20 years of experience, hybrids, SUVs, premium and performance cars, imports and car rental. Customers write about paperwork handled quickly, good aftersales care and cars that match the description.

The website address in the Google listing, xatzismotors.com, does not open, so the website button in the listing leads nowhere. The only page online is a free Google Sites page without a domain of its own. Checked on 21 September 2026.
